title: Conjugator Lengths and Isoperimetric functions
summary: We show that for any recognizing $S$-machine $\textbf{S}$ with superadditive time function $f$, there exists a finitely presented group whose conjugator length function is quadratic and whose Dehn function grows like the square of $f$. This result is dual to that of a previous paper of the authors, which constructed a family of groups with cubic Dehn function that have various conjugator length functions.
